stories.title: Dylan Cease Is Having a Season — AL Cy Young Case Is Building

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Dylan Cease is building a legitimate AL Cy Young case.

The Blue Jays ace: 6-4, 2.56 ERA, 148 K across 17 starts — and led all of MLB with 49 strikeouts in July.

The first Blue Jays pitcher to start the All-Star Game since Roy Halladay in 2009.

#BlueJays #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
With Skubal likely heading to a contender, where does Dylan Cease rank in the AL Cy Young race?

He's 6-4, 2.56 ERA, 148 K — and just won July with 49 strikeouts in 6 starts.

The case is real.

#BlueJays #MLB #CyYoung

article.headline: Dylan Cease Is the AL's Pitcher of July — and the Cy Young Case Is Real

stories.title: Ohtani Hits HR No. 23 as DH — Mound Return Could Come This Weekend

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Shohei Ohtani hit his 23rd home run as DH on July 31 (vs. Red Sox).

Dodgers manager Dave Roberts says he hopes Ohtani can start throwing again as early as this weekend.

He hasn't pitched since July 3.

#Dodgers #MLB

stories.title: Chris Sale Is Making History at Age 37

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Chris Sale at 37: 12-6, 2.08 ERA, 143 K across 20 starts for Atlanta.

His ERA is the 3rd-lowest by any pitcher age 37+ since 1950 — behind only Clemens (1.40 in 2005) and Verlander (1.73 in 2022).

Also: fastest pitcher ever to reach 2,500 career K by IP.

#Braves #MLB

article.headline: Chris Sale at 37 Is Making the History Books — The Numbers Are Remarkable
